meta.title: ANATOMICA muscular system inventory — Milestone 4
meta.source_tables: data/sources/bodyparts3d-4.0/ (BP3D 4.0 / FMA concept ids and names as released)
meta.counting_convention: One record per lateralised instance where the tables lateralise (right/left as separate records, mirroring the skeletal module); one record for an un-sided class concept modelled jointly; one record per side for a parts-composite muscle (a muscle with no whole-muscle concept in BP3D 4.0, represented only by lateralised head/part concepts — heads and parts are geometry components, never separate records); numbered instances (lumbricals, interossei) count individually per side and number as FMA names them. Where FMA/BP3D models a muscle only as a set (hand interossei and lumbricals, levatores costarum, cervical intertransversarii, interspinales cervicis/lumborum), the set is one record per side where lateralised, else one un-sided record. Groups, families, zones and part concepts are not records.

absences.note: probe-based gap analysis: each probe name was counted over all six BP3D 4.0 release tables. Zero hits = the name does not occur in the release; the muscle has no BP3D concept and no record. Probes with hits are listed under 'present' and are not absences.
